entries.title: Verify Windows bridge installation across environments
fixed: Validate Windows installer paths using their canonical filesystem identity so shortened profile paths pass the release checks.

entries.title: Connect the hosted board to your local Codex chat
added: Windows SharedBoard Bridge and guided webpage setup for pairing an existing Codex conversation without editing configuration files.
Two-way browser mini chat, exact-revision board tools, rendered context, read/edit permissions, and browser-saved AI history with safe undo.
Bundled-runtime bridge installer, Open bridge link, and versioned GitHub downloads.
fixed: Reliable delivery receipts, durable retry IDs, cross-tab ownership and deadlines preserve browser data through disconnections and uncertain responses.

entries.title: Reliable board bookmarks on Cloudflare
fixed: Use the canonical root for saved-board URL rewrites so Cloudflare accepts direct board links.

entries.title: Browser beta and public source publishing
added: Browser-storage edition for static hosting: drawings, images, projects, notes, blocks, checkpoints and recovery in IndexedDB.
Cloudflare Pages build and GitHub deployment workflow, with self-contained assets, backups and browser storage controls.
Creator attribution for Andrew Barresi and public source distribution under the MIT license.
fixed: AI connections remain clearly marked WIP in the hosted edition while local connections continue in the portable app.
Removed publish dates from the changelog and protected browser imports and cross-tab startup updates.

entries.title: SharedBoard.app branding
fixed: Use SharedBoard.app throughout the interface, AI tools, launchers, documentation, release metadata and portable ZIP filenames.

entries.title: Preserve labeled shapes during AI text edits
fixed: Apply shape text changes to their visible bound labels while preserving the requested frame dimensions.
Reject stale shape edits after a person changes its label, preserve compound label edits and keep AI undo available after browser text wrapping.

entries.title: Complete portable package validation
fixed: Complete exact-version third-party notice coverage for bundled drawing components and fonts.
Reject linked first-party files before packaging and verify runtime, asset, notice and content hashes.

entries.title: SharedBoard.app local testing package
added: Portable Windows x64 ZIP with a verified bundled Node runtime, double-click launch/stop controls and tester setup guide.
fixed: Rename the application to SharedBoard.app while preserving existing boards, tool IDs and backup compatibility.
Keep ChatGPT and Claude web connectors visible but locked as WIP in both the interface and backend.
Isolate each extracted copy and exclude personal boards, chats, credentials and developer dependencies from distribution.

entries.title: More reliable web connection startup
fixed: Allow extra startup time for new connector addresses to resolve and show DNS wait progress.
Report specific DNS, TLS, HTTP and metadata verification failures instead of blaming the network.
Cancel in-flight connection checks promptly and close temporary routes after failed verification.

entries.title: Separate projects and clearer AI collaboration
added: Separate projects and boards with stable local addresses and independent drawings, planning, messages, history and AI connections.
Explicit mini-chat attachment previews for the board, a selection or a named area, with captured images and requirements.
An object outline and clickable minimap with naming, search, visibility, locking and layer controls.
A proposals-only AI permission enforced for local helpers and the web connector.
Rolling automatic recovery saves before significant changes, with preview and restore separate from named checkpoints.
Formatted chat replies, tables, safe links, copyable code blocks, resizable chat and board-specific drafts.
A compact workspace sidebar, visible AI connection status and expanded chat that remains readable in short windows.
fixed: Board switching keeps grants and in-flight requests pinned to the original board; helper instructions target the correct board directory.
Context previews and pending-review deduplication respect planning changes and empty named areas.
Renaming an unopened board persists correctly, and app shutdown also closes boards still starting.
Restore safety saves use automatic history without consuming named checkpoint slots.

entries.title: Reliable starting actions
fixed: Empty-canvas buttons receive clicks above the editor input layer.
The AI understanding check copies the handoff for connections that require manual delivery.

entries.title: A workspace for real app planning
added: Named areas, project naming, board text search and a collapsible planning navigator.
Anchored notes, requirements and work cards with canvas markers and jump-to-context actions.
Pinned screenshot references, five editable planning templates and a personal reusable block library.
Reviewable AI drawing proposals with before/after previews, conflict checks and protected AI undo.
Named checkpoints with previews and recovery saves, plus portable .sharedboard project backups.
Rendered board images and captured visual context for AI tools, alongside immutable notes and requirements.
Contextual selection controls, grouping, alignment, duplication, locking, an alignment grid and a guided empty canvas.
fixed: AI text edits stay centered in their existing cards; editor text measurements no longer falsely block AI undo.
Drawing imports retain groups and remap frame references. Rejected stale chat sends can capture the current board on retry.

entries.title: A versioned workspace
added: A version badge and an in-app changelog accessible from the footer.
A release workflow that keeps the application, MCP tools and changelog versions together.

entries.title: Shared editing foundation
added: A persistent local canvas with shared human and AI editing, conflict detection and drawing import/export.
Sharedboard drawing controls, fullscreen, board reviews and a floating mini chat.
Guided AI pairing and a temporary ChatGPT / Claude connector for account testing.
